description: The manifest.json entry of a .sltwx, .sltwxa or .sltwxd container (docs/specs/FILE_FORMAT.md). Readers keep fields they do not know, so additional properties are allowed at the top level and inside units. The reference reader is read_manifest in crates/swx-io/src/manifest.rs.

created_by.description: Application and version that created the document.

document_id.description: Stable document identity: a UUID in 8-4-4-4-12 hex form, upper or lower case, as read_manifest accepts.

format.description: Container format name. read_manifest accepts only "sltwx".

format_version.description: Format version as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH in decimal digits. read_manifest accepts major version 0 only; newer minor and patch versions are read.

kind.description: Which kind of document the container holds. read_manifest accepts exactly these three values.

model_hash.description: Optional hash of the canonical model.json: "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex digits, as read_manifest accepts.

saved_by.description: Application and version that last saved the document.

units.description: The document's units by unit name. read_manifest requires length, angle and mass as strings and keeps any other entries.

title: Saulitwerx manifest.json, format v0.1
